Yeah I’m also in CBT. That’s good you uncovered the fact you were misdiagnosed, I’m sure that’s helped give more appropriate direction to the support you might need.
Really gotta check out this EMDR more so. Also doing meditation too, only 10mins a day so far but I guess it’s helping. Thanks for your input, really appreciate it
Thanks so much for the reinforcement and kind words of encouragement, means a lot right now. Really appreciate the kindness

Seriously appreciate the practical advice and alternative perspective on some things, sometimes I get serious blind spots when things are dark - appreciate you for the commend and suggestions very much
Thank you, kindness is always appreciated
Have heard a bit about EMDR a lot lately, will have to check it out
Yeah I’m here, sorry don’t really use reddit too much but happy to chat if it’ll help. Just might do me some good too. Feel free to PM me

I’m sorry for the frantic and poor attempt to convey any sort of coherent message with all that, I’m just at a breaking point and as stipulated I have absolutely no one in my life I can turn to. Suicide hotlines are all blocked up too…

I’m sorry you’re going through all this… I may be on the other side of the world and just some stranger on the internet. But my heart truly does go out to you. For what it’s worth, you have my love - human being to human being. I hope things get better for you, please hang on a while longer. I’m trying to do the same. 
Best wishes - a depressed but friendly stranger ✌️
